changelog.change: Removed canonical_url. The row is url_key, published_on and item_id.
changelog.why: Nothing on the read path opened it: load_published maps url_key to published_on by name. It was 48.6 percent of a row on a ledger with no time bound. The address is recoverable by joining item_id and published_on against that day's payload, which retention may not touch.

changelog.change: Initial shape: the address, the day it ran, and the item it ran as.
changelog.why: A freshness window cannot stop a repeat on its own. Late-evening articles are still inside the window the next morning.

description:
One row of `state/published.csv`, appended when an item reaches a committed digest.

It carries no address. `item_id` and `published_on` join to that day's
committed payload, where the address is already published as `source_url` -
see `docs/architecture/sources/freshness.md` for the worked recovery.

published_on.description: The digest date, not the article's own date.
published_on.title: Published On

title: PublishedRow
